content: OTel GenAI semconv (gen_ai.*) is still experimental status as of 2026; attrs like gen_ai.request.model, gen_ai.usage.input_tokens/output_tokens, gen_ai.operation.name exist. Anti-pattern: storing full prompt/completion text as span attributes (indexed, size-limited, PII exposure) -- use span events/gen_ai.input.messages instead, opt-in via content capture env var. Use OTEL_SEMCONV_STABILITY_OPT_IN for dual emission during transitions.
